nodes.label: Database
nodes.description: A structured collection of data where every item has the same significance, emerging as a dominant cultural form of the computer age.

nodes.label: Narrative
nodes.description: A cause-and-effect trajectory of events that creates a unique trajectory through a database, often de-materialized in new media.

nodes.label: Algorithm
nodes.description: A final sequence of simple operations executed by a computer to accomplish a task. Drives interactive narratives and games.

nodes.label: Data Structure
nodes.description: Data organized in a particular way for efficient search and retrieval, complementary to algorithms.

nodes.label: Paradigm
nodes.description: A set of related elements from which choices are made (implicit in traditional media, explicitly materialized in new media databases).

nodes.label: Syntagm
nodes.description: A linear sequence or combination of signs, representing the actualized narrative trajectory.

nodes.label: Navigable Space
nodes.description: A 3D virtual environment where navigation through space becomes a central action for narrative and exploration.

edges.label: Serves as Interface for Data Visualization
